utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you still do the carpool tomorrow, or should I make other arrangements?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can still do it tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with the carpool if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus — that’d be a big help. I’m a little all over the place, so I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem at all — I can help keep it organized and make the handoff a little easier.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hi Pia — I was just going to ask if the carpool still needs one more driver. I can help if you’re still sorting it out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, thank you — I think we still do, but I’m trying to confirm the timing and who’s covering which day first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — just let me know the days and I can fill in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you tell me where you’ll be picking everyone up and what time you’ll leave?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can pick everyone up at my place on Maple Street and leave around 7:30. If that changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely — I can spread the word about the carpool right away. If you want, I’ll ask around and see who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’d really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll ask around today and let you know who’s interested.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help get the carpool sorted. What days and times are you looking at?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. I’m looking at weekday mornings around 8:00 and afternoons around 5:30.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That works—I’ll note weekday mornings around 8:00 and afternoons around 5:30. I’ll check who’s available and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me of the pickup time and who’s in the carpool? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m a bit late to this, but I don’t have the carpool details in front of me. If you want, I can check and get back to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — please check and send me the pickup time and who’s in it, and I’ll confirm once I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara — I’m just checking the carpool schedule for this week. What time should I plan on for pickup?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Faye — I’m not sure of the pickup time yet. I’ll check the schedule and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate it. Just let me know when you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m probably the last to hear, but did we decide who’s taking the kids in the carpool this week?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t think it’s settled yet, but I can check with everyone and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that. Just let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what time are we doing carpool?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Around 7:30, if that still works for you?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, 7:30 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the carpool. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — I was thinking around 8:00 if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 8:00 works for me. Just let me know where you want to meet.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll mention the carpool plan to everyone and make sure we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’ll keep track of the sign-up and supplies on my end.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll bring up the carpool plan with everyone and keep us coordinated.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll check on the carpool and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. Just let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out now, and I’ll update you as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the carpool. I’m pretty sure I can do my usual day, but I should double-check the time before I promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, that makes sense—I’ll check the carpool time too, and then I can repeat the plan to everyone once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik. Let me know what time you find, and I’ll confirm my part right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey Leo—carpool, right? I’m a bit scattered, but what’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, just a quick update—pickup is still at 8, but I need to swap Tuesday with Wednesday. If that works, we’re good.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, Tuesday and Wednesday swapped works for me. I’ll just remember: pickup stays at 8.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can help with that carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’d like to keep it simple: can you pick up Mrs. Lane and me on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 8:15?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can do Tuesdays and Thursdays at 8:15. I’ll swing by for you and Mrs. Lane, same spot each time?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Quinn, I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara! I’m thinking around 7:30 in the morning—does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: 7:30 works for me. I can take the first leg if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help coordinate the carpool—who needs a ride and what time should we leave?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of everyone’s pickup spots and times—just send me the names and addresses, and I’ll organize it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Opal—I’ll send over the names and addresses soon. If you can, also note any kids’ booster seats or timing preferences.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m just organizing the carpool schedule now. What days or times work best for you?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Rosa — weekday mornings work best for me, especially after 8:30. I can also do early afternoons if needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s helpful — I’ll put you down for weekday mornings after 8:30, with early afternoons as a backup. Thanks, Cleo!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest—how’s the carpool working out?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s going fine, but we still need one more driver on Wednesdays. Can you help with that?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can ask around and see if anyone’s available for Wednesdays.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what time are we leaving?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let’s leave at 7:30 so we can get there before the bell.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, 7:30 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the carpool. What time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Morning works best for me — around 8:00 AM is ideal.
